drafted_from: tool:record-a-web-demo row in tools/record-a-web-page/tool-rows.json, do-work/record-a-web-demo.mjs and test/record-a-web-page.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Record a demo of https://bakery.example/ where I hover Features, type Ada in the name box, click Say hello and scroll down, with a red click ripple and a caption on the hover and the click." It runs tool:record-a-web-demo and hands you an MP4, a GIF and one marked picture per step.
no_lists_because: It names no list: it takes a page address and steps, and answers a video, a GIF and step pictures kept in your files.
instructions: 1. Choose the page (url) and write the steps in order; each step is {do: click, hover, type, press, scroll, wait or go, target: {text} or {selector}, caption} and a step with a target or a caption gets its own picture.

2. Say "Record a demo of this page" with the steps; your AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:record-a-web-demo and input {url, steps, and optionally width, height, output_width, fps, cursor_size, zoom, gif_width, cookies, look}.

3. Read the answer: result gives seconds, frames, width, height, fps, video_bytes and one entry per step with whether its target was found; files gives the video, the gif and the step pictures (a cover picture at the first click and one marked picture per step).

4. A step whose target is not on the page stops the run with a message naming the step; mark a notice or banner step optional: true to leave it out when it does not show. For a signed-in page give cookies from a disposable account, since the run keeps its input.

worked_examples.title: Four steps on a page with a menu, a name box and a button
worked_examples.ask: Record a demo of the bakery page: hover Features, type Ada, click Say hello, scroll.
worked_examples.given: From tools/record-a-web-page/test/record-a-web-page.test.mjs, which runs these exact steps and options against its own small test page (test/menu-page.html, with a Features menu, a #name field and a Say hello button) in a 1280 by 720 window; https://bakery.example/ stands in for that page here.
worked_examples.hands_back: result {width: 960, height: 540, fps: 30, seconds, frames, video_bytes, steps: [one entry per step with found true, true, true and false (the scroll has no target) and at_seconds for each]}; files: video demo.mp4 (960 pixels wide, a red ripple drawn where the pointer clicked), gif demo.gif, and the pictures cover.png, step-01.png, step-02.png and step-03.png (the scroll step has no picture). A click on the words "Nowhere on this page" at step 2 stops the run with "Step 2 (click) could not find the words".
